response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent craftsmanship practices, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role. His C++ expertise is outdated (last used 2014-2015, 11+ years ago) and was never a primary focus. More critically, his entire career trajectory over the past decade has been in web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React), with zero demonstrated experience in industrial automation, IoT protocols (MQTT, Modbus, IEC standards), embedded systems, or security standards (IEC 62443/SDL) that are core requirements. Significant reskilling would be required.
strengths: Proven strong software craftsmanship with deep expertise in TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and development best practices that align with quality requirements
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing capability through organizing code dojos, creating training courses, and contributing to developer tooling and frameworks
Multi-language versatility and experience optimizing high-performance, low-latency systems handling millions of concurrent requests, showing systems-level thinking
concerns: C++ expertise is outdated and minimal; last C++ work was 2014-2015 at National Instruments; career has heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js/web development for past 11 years
Complete absence of industrial automation, IoT, and embedded systems domain expertise; no experience with required protocols (MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, IEC 104, OPC UA)
No demonstrated knowledge of critical security standards (IEC 62443, SDL) or secure development lifecycle practices required for industrial-cybersecurity context

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial automation and security standards domain knowledge
Strong software engineering practices and mentoring capability
